methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a Norfolk native directly signal distributed capacity-building through peer networks, attempting to close the technology gap through grassroots education rather than platform dependency or institutional concentration.

signals.title: What is the University’s role in the Commonwealth AI Institute? - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: The Commonwealth AI Institute anchored at UVA signals state investment concentrating around existing research universities, reinforcing deep capability in academic hubs rather than distributing AI fluency to underserved regions.

signals.title: How one Virginia county’s AI platform protects sensitive data - Route Fifty
signals.signal_reading: A Virginia county building its own AI platform with privacy protections demonstrates local capacity for deep, customized implementation beyond vendor platforms, suggesting distributed technical capability at the municipal governance level.

signals.title: Virginia Tech sets course for human-centered AI leadership - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's human-centered AI leadership initiative positions a non-NoVA institution as a capability hub, potentially distributing deep AI expertise through the New River Valley and countering pure metropolitan concentration.

signals.title: Roanoke College joins Google AI for Education Accelerator - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College joining Google's AI Education Accelerator signals platform-mediated adoption in a rural area—broad but potentially shallow implementation dependent on vendor tools rather than indigenous capability development.
